previous_canonical:
DOUBLE BONELESS / BONELESS DOUBLE PURGE
[GTOP OWNER CLARIFICATION, REVISION 4]

Two distinct paired descriptors apply to any asset and any range play with a relevant correlated comparison: 9ate8, Young Lefty, GCT or others. Keep the underlying play. Boneless alone needs non-confirmation at one side.

DOUBLE BONELESS (V1)
The same asset purges neither parent-range boundary; it stays boneless on both sides. Its counterpart supplies the qualifying Double Purge. Preserve the original completed objective, then the opposing purge and required inside close on the selected parent timeframe. An opposing objective touch or lower-timeframe return alone is insufficient. Track later reversal delivery separately. Roles do not switch.

BONELESS DOUBLE PURGE (V2)
Different correlated assets purge the opposing boundaries of corresponding parent ranges. Each purges only one side and stays boneless at the side purged by its partner. Neither individually forms a Double Purge; the second purge is on the counterpart. Roles switch between sides. V1's individual Double Purge requirement does not apply to V2. These names are distinct, not interchangeable aliases.

Both retain existing Boneless qualification, parent-timeframe setup intervals and required closing confirmation. Minutes of separation alone are not non-confirmation. Incomplete intervals or missing paired candles remain unverified. Track each asset's physical purges and delivery; counterpart movement is not a local objective touch. No fixed buy-side-first or sell-side-first order, new entry, tier, automatic V6, automatic full-objective completion, guaranteed reversal or profit follows. Same-asset double purge alone is not Double Boneless; generic "double purge" is not an alias.

JOURNALING
Keep underlying play in play and exact descriptor in context_notes/evidence_notes. Capture supplied/verified variant, assets, ranges, sides, sequence, timeframe and close; actual delivery and executions are separate. Missing details/variant never block saving. Preserve raw narration, reported labels, uncertainty and corrections; do not silently relabel historical journals or treat a label as verified classification. Concept questions alone never start a journal. No automatic detector, alert or live historical verification is added.

previous_revisions.accepted:
DOUBLE BONELESS
[GTOP TERMINOLOGY / OWNER CLARIFICATION]

Double Boneless describes a correlated setup with a boneless leg at both opposing sides of liquidity. At one side, one asset purges its corresponding liquidity while its correlated counterpart does not. At the opposite side, the counterpart purges its corresponding liquidity while the first asset does not. The purging and boneless roles switch between the two sides.

Double Boneless can describe any asset and any range play with a relevant correlated comparison. It is not limited to 9ate8: Double Boneless 9ate8, Double Boneless Young Lefty and Double Boneless GCT are examples of the same descriptor applied to different plays.

The underlying play, selected ranges and existing Boneless qualification remain distinct. The descriptor records paired liquidity behavior. Record each physical purge and nonpurge against its own asset and corresponding range.

Do not infer a new execution model, entry trigger, risk tier, CRT variant, reversal, time limit or automatic full-objective completion from this descriptor alone. Preserve actual local objective touches and paired delivery context separately. No fixed buy-side-first or sell-side-first order is established by this clarification.

accepted:
FANG 2 IMBALANCE — OWNER CLARIFICATION, 9 NOVEMBER 2026
Fanging describes opposing distributions that create imbalances. Fang 1=Model 1, the body liquidity-purging candle. Fang 2=inverse Model 1: a thick up/down-close candle purging the range with its body in the inverse direction, after Super Soup, before CISD.
Fang 2 Imbalance is an entry method, not a parent play. Tier 1 because it is pre-CISD; keep existing allocations. Do not require CISD first or change Fang 1's tier. Sharp turn/BPR are comparisons, not identical rules.
Fang 2 may CREATE an imbalance through distribution; otherwise look WITHIN that candle on a lower timeframe. These are two entry-reference paths, not separate fills. Apply the same imbalance/FVG rules at this location in time, sequence and price.
Journal literal entry_model, parent play (e.g. 9ate8 or Young Lefty), created/internal imbalance and corrections. Candle reference is not exact fill time/price. Missing optional details don't block saving reported trades. Concept questions alone never start a journal; offer once for an own planned/actual trade, await consent. No detector/alert implementation is established.
